title: Higher and Higher
director: Erwin C. Dietrich, Peter Baumgartner, Jack Hill
actors: Ingrid Steeger, Rolf Eden, Vivian Weiss
plot: A blonde hooks up with a rock star who leaves her after a one-night stand. She fell in love with him however and sets out across Europe to track him down. On her way, she meets a gang of nasty bikers and a ring of devil worshipers.
